name: better-on-average
title: Better on average, not in every draw
idea: The best report has the smallest expected loss within its family under the law that chose it; in a single draw, a common rule can do better.
from: new concept · theory book ch. 16 (conditional Bayes dominance) and ch. 18; postrank vignette m2; picture: the per-draw realized loss of the best report against a common rule's, with the 45° line, the share of draws the rule wins and the mean difference; a toggle takes the rule outside the family
credit: After the postrank theory book, ch. 16.
caption: Conditional posterior experiment: both reports are selected once from the declared law and then fixed across paired whole-state draws. Dominance concerns expected total reporting loss within the named family.
